items.description: FORT CUSTER TRAINING CENTER, Mich. —The Michigan National Guard is hosting more than 200 Soldiers from nine states at Fort Custer Training Center as they work to earn one of three Department of the Army skill badges: the Expert Infantryman Badge, Expert Soldier Badge, or Expert Field Medical Badge. Collectively known as E3B, the event marks the first time a National Guard state has hosted all three badge assessments at once.
